Get ministerial appointments

Source: R/query-tables.R
get_ministry_records.Rd

Reads the ministry_records table, or the v_ministry_records_display view with display = TRUE: one row per ministerial appointment. Front-bench roles and portfolios.

Usage

get_ministry_records(
  ministry_number = NULL,
  PHID = NULL,
  Role = NULL,
  Prep = NULL,
  Entity = NULL,
  RDateStart = NULL,
  RDateEnd = NULL,
  ministry_record_id = NULL,
  ministry_party = NULL,
  ...,
  active_during = NULL,
  display = FALSE,
  columns = NULL,
  collect = TRUE,
  limit = NULL
)

Arguments

ministry_number

Filter on column ministry_number (INTEGER).

PHID

Filter on column PHID (VARCHAR).

Role

Filter on column Role (VARCHAR).

Prep

Filter on column Prep (VARCHAR).

Entity

Filter on column Entity (VARCHAR).

RDateStart

Filter on column RDateStart (DATE).

RDateEnd

Filter on column RDateEnd (DATE).

ministry_record_id

Filter on column ministry_record_id (VARCHAR).

ministry_party

Filter on column ministry_party (VARCHAR).

...

Must be empty. It forces the arguments after it to be named.

active_during

Keep rows whose period overlaps this: a year, a date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD"), or an in_range() of years or dates. The period runs from RDateStart to RDateEnd; a missing RDateEnd means it is ongoing. NULL (the default) applies no date filter.

display

If TRUE, read the v_ministry_records_display view, which adds display columns to the table's own. Filters still apply.

columns

Character vector of columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per ministerial appointment and every column of ministry_records (or of v_ministry_records_display) (zero rows if nothing matches), or a lazy table if collect = FALSE.

Details

Every column except content and *_raw columns is a filter argument, spelt as in the database. Each takes NULL (no filter, the default), a vector of values to match, in_range() for an inclusive range, or matches_pattern() for a case-insensitive pattern. Filters combine with AND. Stored values are returned unchanged, and no other filter is applied.

Generated from the database catalog by data-raw/generate-getters.R; for tables without a getter use db_tbl().

See also

in_range(), matches_pattern(), db_tbl()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
get_ministry_records(Role = matches_pattern("%treasurer%"), active_during = 2000)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 9
#>   ministry_number PHID  Role      Prep  Entity RDateStart RDateEnd  
#>             <int> <chr> <chr>     <chr> <chr>  <date>     <date>    
#> 1              61 CT4   Treasurer ""    ""     1996-03-11 2007-12-03
#> 2              62 CT4   Treasurer ""    ""     1996-03-11 2007-12-03
#> 3              63 CT4   Treasurer ""    ""     1996-03-11 2007-12-03
#> 4              64 CT4   Treasurer ""    ""     1996-03-11 2007-12-03
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: ministry_record_id <chr>, ministry_party <chr>
db_disconnect()
